title: Partner discounts for students
summary: Explains how student partner discounts work when using a debit card at participating textbook partners: 10.0% off at checkout. Covers eligibility checks with participating merchants, receipt retention, potential discount changes on returns/exchanges, and a $5 fee for cashier’s checks.
